name: Clover ~Shiawase no Layout~
source:
A years has passed. Daisuke still lives alone and draws canvases. His ultimate aim is to study in Paris after graduation, but he can't tell it even to his childhood friend Tachibana Amane.

His sister-in-law suddenly moves in with protagonist to cheer him up. It's the last winter vacation of high school, and it can become a turning point in everyone's lives... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一年过去了。大辅仍然独自生活并画画。他的最终目标是毕业后去巴黎学习，但他连青梅竹马的橘天音都不敢告诉。

他的嫂子突然搬来和主角住在一起，让他高兴起来。这是高中的最后一个寒假，它可以成为每个人人生的转折点…… 

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
